title: Tech & Innovation
completion_message: ¡Fantástico! Dominas el vocabulario de las startups y la tecnología moderna. Estás listo para hablar de innovación al más alto nivel.

parts.visual:
Innovación: 
- Disruptive (Disruptivo - que cambia completamente una industria). 
- Cutting-edge (De vanguardia / Lo más avanzado). 
- Paradigm shift (Cambio de paradigma). 
Ej: AI is a disruptive technology causing a paradigm shift in education.
parts.audio: Innovation. Disruptive means changing an industry completely. Cutting-edge means the most advanced or state of the art. Paradigm shift is a fundamental change in approach or underlying assumptions. For example: A I is a disruptive technology causing a paradigm shift in education.

parts.visual:
Startups y Desarrollo: 
- Scale up (Escalar - crecer rápidamente el negocio). 
- Algorithm (Algoritmo). 
- Pain point (Punto de dolor - el problema específico del cliente que tu producto resuelve). 
Ej: To scale up, our algorithm must solve a real pain point.
parts.audio: Startups and Development. Scale up means to grow a business rapidly. Algorithm is a set of rules for a computer. Pain point is the specific problem of the customer that your product solves. For example: To scale up, our algorithm must solve a real pain point.

questions.question: Uber was a ____ technology because it completely changed the taxi industry. (Disruptiva).
questions.explanation: Disruptive = disruptivo (que altera radicalmente un sector).

questions.question: We use ____-edge technology in our laboratories. (De vanguardia / Lo último).
questions.explanation: Cutting-edge (o state-of-the-art) = de última generación, de vanguardia.

questions.question: The invention of the internet caused a paradigm ____ in how we communicate. (Cambio/Giro).
questions.explanation: Paradigm shift = cambio de paradigma (un cambio fundamental).

questions.question: The startup is looking for investors so they can ____ up operations globally. (Escalar / Crecer).
questions.explanation: Scale up = escalar un negocio (crecer sus ingresos rápidamente sin que los costos suban al mismo ritmo).

questions.question: Our app solves a major ____ point for remote workers. (Punto de dolor / Problema principal).
questions.explanation: Pain point = punto de dolor (el problema que frustra al cliente).

questions.question: The social media ____ decides which videos you see on your feed. (Algoritmo).
They created a ____ of the app to test it before the official launch. (Prototipo).
We need an app that is user-____ so older people can use it easily. (Amigable / Fácil de usar).
Our data is stored securely in the ____. (La nube).
Artificial ____ will automate many routine tasks. (Inteligencia).
A sudden system ____ caused us to lose an hour of work. (Fallo / Caída).
questions.explanation: System crash = caída o fallo del sistema.

questions.question: We need to fix this software ____ before the release. (Error / Bicho).
To protect our network from hackers, we improved our ____. (Ciberseguridad).
The company uses machine ____ to analyze customer data. (Aprendizaje).
We are planning to ____ the new feature next week. (Lanzar / Implementar).
questions.explanation: Roll out = lanzar o implementar gradualmente un nuevo producto o función.

questions.question: This software is obsolete; we need to ____ it immediately. (Actualizar).
A tech ____ is a company that has reached a valuation of $1 billion. (Unicornio).
questions.explanation: Unicorn = empresa emergente (startup) valuada en más de 1000 millones de dólares.

questions.question: We use an ____-source platform, which means the code is free for everyone. (Código abierto).
The new interface is highly ____ to fit our specific needs. (Personalizable).
Virtual ____ headsets are becoming very popular in gaming and training. (Realidad).
____ technology. (Disruptiva con D)
____-edge. (De vanguardia con C)
Paradigm ____. (Cambio con S)
To ____ up. (Escalar con S)
A pain ____. (Punto de dolor con P)
The ____. (Algoritmo con A)
User-____. (Amigable/Fácil de usar con F)
Software ____. (Error/Bicho con B)
Machine ____. (Aprendizaje con L)
____-source. (Código abierto con O)
